How it works

A predictable path from first call to final walkthrough.

No guesswork, no surprises. Here's exactly what working with Castro looks like.

Get a free estimate (508) 566-1618

Free estimates

Four steps to a clear quote.

  1. 01

    Tell us what you need

    Share the project and the town it's in — by the form, phone or email. Photos help us understand it faster.

  2. 02

    Quick follow-up

    We get back to you fast to ask the right questions and set a time to come out.

  3. 03

    On-site check

    When needed, we visit to measure, check framing and hidden damage, and talk through materials.

  4. 04

    Clear quote & next steps

    You get an itemized estimate in writing, repair options where they apply, and a realistic timeline.

Your estimate

What you receive after the visit.

Everything you need to make a confident decision — and plan timing and budget.

  • Photos and a clear explanation of what we found
  • Repair options where they apply — the best fix vs. a budget fix
  • An itemized estimate for labor and materials
  • A realistic timeline and what to expect on install day

During the project

Professional work. Clean results. Zero stress.

  • Protected home

    Surfaces covered, access planned and your routine respected.

  • Daily cleanup

    The site is left organized at the end of every day.

  • Clear updates

    You'll know what's happening and what's next — without chasing us.

  • Root problems fixed

    If we find hidden rot or water damage, we show you and explain options before moving on.

  • Detail-driven finish

    Tight joints, straight lines and clean transitions.

  • Final walkthrough

    We review the finished work together before we call it done.
